# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

EBLA is maintained on a best-effort basis. Security fixes are generally
considered for the current 1.1.x development line, which is maintained on
`master`. No separate 1.1.x maintenance branch exists at this time.

| Version / Branch | Security Updates |
| --- | --- |
| 1.1.x (`master`) | Supported on a best-effort basis |
| 1.0.x and earlier | Not actively supported |

Fixes for older releases may be considered at the maintainers' discretion.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report potential security vulnerabilities **privately** using GitHub's
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/bpangburn/ebla/security/advisories/new)
feature. Do not open a public issue or publish exploit details before the
maintainers have had an opportunity to investigate.

Please include, where possible:

- A description of the issue and its potential impact.
- The affected version or commit.
- Steps to reproduce the problem and a proof of concept, if available.
- Any known mitigation or suggested fix.

## Response and Disclosure

This is a best-effort, independently maintained project. Maintainers will
**aim to acknowledge reports within seven days**, but cannot guarantee a
particular response or remediation timeframe.

Reports will be assessed for reproducibility, security impact, and an
appropriate resolution. If a vulnerability is confirmed, maintainers will
endeavor to coordinate remediation and responsible disclosure, and may publish
a GitHub security advisory or corrected release as appropriate.

Not every report will result in a security advisory or software update.
